1.

Down into a death of nameless woe Thy love could go, To save us from the judgment, To cast down the strong one.

2.

Our guilt, yea all upon Thee, Lamb of God, In this hour was laid; Thou didst bear the weight of our sins, God’s judgment and Satan’s power.

3.

The storm that passed over Thee here Is forever stilled, And we may enjoy eternal peace, Thou bearest the crown of victory.

4.

Thy praise we may sing eternally In the Father’s house one day; On earth, where Thou didst suffer and die, We already raise our song.
